scope: Five low-state E1 transitions; numerical reference reproduction and original-source strength cross-checks. No new complete independent P/waist/measured-Rabi benchmark established.

conventions.beamDefinition: Full 1/e^2 intensity diameter D=2*w0; w0 is radius.
conventions.powerDefinition: Power of the selected pure spherical polarization component at the atom, not a 2P display axis.
conventions.fieldBoundary: Unmixed zero-field angular-momentum states; no finite-field mixing, detuning, motion or decoherence corrections.
conventions.uncertaintyBoundary: Printed uncertainties are reference-compatibility bounds. Shared compilation inputs and unknown covariance prevent an independent significance claim.

sources.title: Determination of the 5d6s 3D1 state lifetime and blackbody-radiation clock shift in Yb
sources.locations: PDF p.2 Method II and Eq.(8), p.4 Table III and lifetime results

reported.branchingEvidence: Theoretical LS-coupling branching estimate, not directly measured branching.

sources.independenceBoundary: A source used by the Kroeze compilation. No held-out independence or direct power/waist/Rabi measurement is claimed.

sources.title: Electric-dipole amplitudes, lifetimes, and polarizabilities of the low-lying levels of atomic ytterbium
sources.arxivTitle: E1 amplitudes, lifetimes, and polarizabilities of the low-lying levels of atomic ytterbium
sources.isotopeBoundary: Electronic theory, not an isotope-resolved experimental Rabi measurement.
sources.independenceBoundary: Related theoretical source inputs also enter the compilation branching ratios; no fully independent experimental validation is claimed.

cases.branchingNote: Effectively unity for this electronic transition at the accuracy of this check.

cases.wavelengthNote: Source-table value retained for the source lifetime reconstruction. Canonical wavelength 770.16026840069 nm follows the separately audited frequency; no canonical value is changed by this check.

sourceConflicts.sourceClaim: Sec.6.3 prose and table Omega_0 label claim pi/q=0.
sourceConflicts.resolution: Use the explicitly printed sublevels: q=mp-m=+1 for T1,T2,T5,T6 and -1 for T7. Literal q=0 gives zero for each of those same pairs. This is an explicit conflict resolution, not a fitted polarization.
Use total Gamma=1/tau in s^-1 and ordinary linewidth Gamma/(2*pi) in Hz; do not interpret the extra 2pi printed in the compilation FWHM rows as a physical multiplicative factor.

excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.reported: Pump Rabi approximately 1.2 MHz in saturated absorption.
excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.missing: Matching pump power and both elliptical waist radii, plus direct time-domain Rabi-fit evidence. MOT beam parameters belong to a different experiment.

excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.reason: 5 ms is probe duration, not a measured pi pulse; 50 um waist is for lattice light, not the repumper. No matched direct Rabi benchmark.
Hollow-cathode-lamp pressure/power broadened MTS width is not a cold-atom coherent Rabi frequency.
Hollow-cathode-lamp MTS; incoming laser-source power is not a matched atom-plane power/waist/Rabi measurement.

excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.missing: Numerical 1389 nm waist; only a qualitative multiple of the 35 um clock waist is reported. Do not infer or fit it.

excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.reason: Lifetime measurement on 174Yb, useful as electronic-strength input but not a direct 171Yb experimental Rabi benchmark.

excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.source: Beloy 2012, Phys. Rev. A 86, 051404(R), PDF p.4
excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.reported: Up to 1 mW, a 30 um spot, I approximately 7e5 W/m^2, and Omega exceeding 1 GHz.
excludedExperimentalBenchmarks.reason: An apparatus scale estimate without a fitted same-mF-channel Rabi datum. Omega is not automatically Omega/(2*pi); total linear polarization power also needs component/channel specification. Not an exact matched experimental pass/fail test.

boundaries.reason: Main transition is M2 excitation with hyperfine-induced E1 decay contributions. No generic applicable E1 dipole is established; the total lifetime cannot determine one universal E1 coupling.
Prior 70 nW/200 um/60 ms nominal pi-time comparison disagrees with the current internal dF. No new dipole fitted here.
